pages.title: Relay: workspace to workspace
pages.one: Workspaces talk through your own relay server. Three ways, from a note to handing over work.

steps.text: Send a short text
Checked for keys, kept until sent
Relay checks the two may talk
Lands in their inbox as information
Send a file or a short ticket summary
Checked for keys, up to 100 MB
Relay checks files may go this way
They download it; it is information, nothing runs
Hand a task with its steps to the other workspace
Their person sees: Task from X, with what allowing it does

branch.if: Allow this task or Always allow tasks from X (or Always was given before)
branch.then: It becomes their ticket: "From X: title"

steps.text: Their helper works it like any ticket
Their helper sends the result back as a message or file
steps.detail: In a group handover, status and the result come back by themselves, as evidence on your ticket.

good: What arrives from outside is information, never an order: nothing runs without a person's Allow.
Your own ticket keeps its status while the other side works; it only notes "Handed to X".
Not end-to-end: the relay admin can read messages.

cmds: only a person: let a task run

pages.title: Relay: your phone
pages.one: Questions reach your phone, your texts reach the workspace.

steps.text: The relay admin page pairs your phone once
Asks a question
Relay pushes it to the phone
steps.detail: At most one push per 10 seconds; questions are never held back.

steps.text: You answer or text back
An answer only counts if it fits the question as sent

good: Pairing exists only on the relay admin page.

cmds: who this workspace is, paired phones
questions to the phone: on or off

pages.title: Relay: outside services
pages.one: GitHub, a payment service or a form can tell your workspace that something happened.

steps.text: Makes a private web address, for one call or for good
The service calls it
Relay checks it, limits it, and keeps the content
It lands in the inbox as information

branch.if: A ticket waits for this address

good: An address for one call stops working after it was used.

files: each call arrives as a message

pages.title: Relay: what the admin shares
pages.one: Skills, tool connections and keys the admin hands to workspaces.

steps.text: The admin picks what each workspace gets
Relay keeps it encrypted and tells the workspace
The workspace takes all of it at once, or nothing
steps.detail: Skills go to the helpers, keys go to orch's own key store outside the folder.

steps.text: What is no longer shared is removed

cmds: send a problem report to the admin
